purpose: Convert versioned multi-source evidence into auditable D1-D6 evidence states and next-evidence recommendations without producing a total talent score or diagnostic label.

evidence_states.INSUFFICIENT: No usable evidence, or evidence does not meet the minimum source rule.
evidence_states.SINGLE_SOURCE: Usable evidence exists but comes from only one independent source class.
evidence_states.CONVERGENT: At least two independent usable source classes provide materially compatible evidence.
evidence_states.DISCREPANT: At least two independent usable source classes provide materially conflicting evidence or context changes interpretation.

quality_rules: WITHDRAWN evidence is excluded from routing.
LIMITED evidence may contextualise a route but cannot independently establish convergence.
CONFLICTING evidence must remain visible and cannot be averaged away.
Every route output stores links to the evidence events used.
Every route run snapshots the engine policy and version.
High-consequence Golden Path synthesis requires human review.
